## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- `supabase_reset_owner_password` and `verify_ses_email_identity` actions require confirmText `CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION` (NOT `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`)
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED ≠ VERIFIED; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete
- **CRITICAL SECURITY**: never display/log/store passwords in screenshots, logs, analytics, alerts, proof reports; redact as ********; never hardcode passwords; never bypass Supabase auth
- **NEVER reset owner password without explicit owner approval** — owner was angry when password was reset to a generated value without asking
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use Python `gzip.compress()` + `base64.b64encode()`; repo-root relative paths
- **Rork sandbox `git push` goes to Rork git router, NOT canonical GitHub** — must use owner-gated `github_commit_file` API to push to canonical repo
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Render restart API: `{action: "render_restart_service", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`
- Render update source: `{action: "render_update_source", input: {branch: "main", commitSha}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at.json` (JSON with `accessToken` + `refreshToken` fields); re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; **Supabase refresh_token approach FAILS with 401 — must re-mint via passwordless login endpoint**
- APK/landing presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with top-level `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD"}` (NOT nested under action/input) — returns `uploadUrl` (S3 presigned PUT) + `publicUrl`; then PUT the file to `uploadUrl`
- Landing upload whitelist pattern: `^(index\.html|reset-password\.html|robots\.txt|sitemap\.xml|ivx-[a-z0-9-]{1,60}\.(js|json)|landing-support-chat\.(js|css))$`
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Health endpoint: `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returns `{commit, status}` — use to verify deploy propagation
- `bun test backend/` = **1711 pass / 0 fail (6240 expects)**
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout; Render propagation ~2-5 min; use nohup background + poll for long ops
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before tests or tsc; **must run `bun install` in BOTH `/home/user/rork-app` AND `/home/user/rork-app/expo`** (root install gives ~258 packages, expo install gives ~1311 packages)
- `watchman` disabled (renamed to `/usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled`) to prevent Metro/Gradle build hangs
- **MFA must be optional, OFF by default** — owner was very angry it was enforced; demanded immediate removal and proof
- Owner authorized backend bypass for AAL2 — wants it fixed now without touching Supabase dashboard
- **Owner demands Amazon/Instagram-level sign-in UX** — said "I need to have sign in like Amazon level Instagram level you provide very poor level"
- Owner frustrated when assistant stops mid-build — demands end-to-end completion, not partial status reports
- **Owner wants Rork to work autonomously as a senior developer** — "make ivx free to work free like you as senior developer think as senior developer work as same level senior developer"
